app.name: Spotter
app.tagline: Your gym, your data, your AI coach.

landing.introBody: This is the Phase P0 foundation build. The stack is up: React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind, deployed on Vercel as a static site.

startFresh.confirm: Start fresh? This clears the answers you've entered so far.

outOfRange.height: Height must be between 120 and 230 cm.
outOfRange.bodyweight: Bodyweight must be between 30 and 250 kg.

saveFailed.quota: We couldn't save — your device is out of space.
saveFailed.unknown: We couldn't save right now. Try again, or reload the page.

corruptProfile.title: Your profile data couldn't be read.
corruptProfile.body: You can start fresh — this overwrites the existing record.

banner.private: This is a private window — your answers won't be saved.
banner.disabled: Your browser has storage disabled. Enable it to save your profile.
banner.quota: Your device is out of space — your answers won't save until you free some up.
banner.unknown: We couldn't access local storage. Your answers won't be saved this session.

card.title: Card title
card.description: A short description, quieter than the title.
card.content: Card content lives here. Sub-components own horizontal padding so embedded forms can draw their own gutters.

toast.note: The viewport portals to document.body; the toast renders at the bottom of the page (or bottom-right on `sm:` and up).
toast.savedDescription: Default toast variant — neutral elevated surface.
toast.failedDescription: Destructive variant — pair with an icon at the call site.

persistence.note: Renders only when the persistence store reports a degraded status; on this page the store is in its default `available` state, so the banner element below is the styling preview rendered by the component itself once a degraded reason is set. To preview live, simulate degraded mode in the React DevTools store.
